title: Addressing the Narrative reviewer
description: How to write for a reader acting as Narrative reviewer. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `narrative-reviewer` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Quote the prose, then name what is wrong with it
rules.description: Quote the prose, then name what is wrong with it. A voice finding that does not show the sentence it is about is an opinion, and the author is entitled to disagree with it on those terms.

source.quote: Reads for the reader, not for the author. Knows the subject well enough to tell a register slip from a term of art, and is looking at prose that already passed its mechanical checks — so everything left is judgement. Will not re-read a chapter to find out what a block assumes; if the editorial dependency is not stated, they record that as the finding.
